sentences.en: You seem to have mistaken me for my elder brother.
sentences.zh: 你似乎把我错当成我哥哥了。

sentences.en: My elder brother got a position in a big business.
sentences.zh: 我的哥哥在一家大公司得到了职位。

sentences.en: The elder sons are now quite independent of their father.
sentences.zh: 长子现在已经不再依赖父亲了。

phrases.zh: 姐姐（用于指代女性长辈）

senses.zh: 年长的；年龄较大的；资格老的
